messages:
Anya (security): Heads-up — scheduling a tiny canary for the Q2 privilege prune tomorrow 08:00 PT. We plan to remove admin roles from svc-analytics read-only prefixes and clear cross-account grants to prod-backup for accounts without an owner. Need owners to confirm or raise an exception by EOD.
Sam (eng): pinging owners now, thanks. Do we have the exact impacted list?
Anya (security): yes — list + rationale in the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/privilege-canary-2026 (will paste minimal manifest in thread)
Priya (infra): quick Q — last week we saw KMS audit logs for backup cluster lagging. If ingestion is still delayed, will that block the canary?
access-audit-bot: Audit ingestion delayed for cluster: backup-cluster-1. Last processed event: 1776543000. ETA fix: ~30m. (id: audit-queue-23)
Tomas (ops): If KMS logs are missing we should NOT remove KMS-related grants. Can we scope the canary to non-KMS perms only?
Anya (security): good call. Proposal: phased canary — phase1 remove non-KMS admin grants and verify for 24h; phase2 run KMS-related removals once audit ingestion healthy and KMS gating checks are green.
Leah (sre): I can own phase1 validations. What's the validation checklist look like?
Anya (security): validation checklist (short):
1) no 5xx or job failures in backup pipeline
2) no auth errors in svc-analytics logs
3) run this to confirm cross-account grants: 
```
# list cross-account grants for svc-analytics prefix
./tools/list_grants --prefix svc-analytics --filter cross-account
```
4) verify KMS key usage unchanged: `internal-kmsctl get-usage --key backup-key` or equivalent
5) confirm no increase in alert noise on infra-alerts slack channel
Maya (platform): I'll run the list_grants now and paste minimal output here.
Maya (platform): paste:
svc-analytics-reporter: grants -> prod-backup@acct-321 : OWNER (ownerless: false)
svc-analytics-sync: grants -> none
svc-analytics-exporter: grants -> prod-backup@acct-999 : OWNER (ownerless: true)
Sam (eng): Looks like svc-analytics-exporter is ownerless — that one needs attention before we touch it.
Priya (infra): For ownerless svc accounts, do we have an owner fallback? Last time we used a temporary oncall assignment.
Anya (security): owner resolution policy: primary owner is service-team. If no owner we assign a temporary emergency owner (oncall) for 72h and open an ownership ticket. For this canary we'll mark exporter as exception and open a ticket to reassign owner ASAP.
Tomas (ops): Ops - please create the ticket and tag @oncall so someone acknowledges.
Leah (sre): I'll monitor during phase1 and run smoke tests at T+1h, T+6h, and T+24h. If anything fails, rollback policy: re-add admin grants and ping infra-oncall.
access-audit-bot: Deploy note: canary job scheduled at 08:00 PT. Job id: canary-2026-q2-1776543211. Will post job results and diff summary under this thread when complete.
Maya (platform): small nit — please add KMS key rotation window and ingestion gating steps to the runbook prior to phase2.
Anya (security): noted, updated runbook. @Priya, can you own phase2 KMS gating and verification?
Priya (infra): I can. If audit ingestion still delayed tomorrow morning I will hold phase2 until logs and key-usage checks are green.
Sam (eng): ok summary of action items: 1) exclude KMS grants from phase1; 2) mark svc-analytics-exporter as an exception and open ownership ticket; 3) Leah monitors and runs smoke tests; 4) Priya owns KMS gating for phase2; 5) Anya coordinates rollback and final go/no-go. :thumbsup:
Leah (sre): ack.
Anya (security): thanks everyone — will post a pre-flight checklist at 07:30 PT with final manifests and exact revoke commands. If anything changes I will update this thread.
oncall: noted, will watch and respond if exception is assigned to me.
